title: Perceptual profile evolution, Rosetta reveal procedures and corrected development-tool hierarchy

before.state: Canonical Visual Grammar and Writer READ/WRITE existed, but interference/depth/emergent reveal semantics were not connected to Writer Rosetta entries and the ecosystem documentation incorrectly treated Tonal as Origami profile-promotion authority.

after.state: Origami keeps one canonical aesthetic per profile version, supports explicit Rosetta reveal procedures for promoted interference/depth/temporal/emergent channels, and defines the hierarchy correctly: development tools such as Tlaloc propose and experiment; Origami owns promotion of Origami profiles; Tonal optionally composes multiple development tools such as Tlaloc and Blueprint Framework.
